txt: *BAM*! You find yourself on the roof... having mastered the art of physical displacement.
*Great* can-do attitude! A billion reál mindset. Clinically *insane* energy! Hire him on the spot!!
*One* coin. The first of many. Imagine so many coins you're going to need to hire someone to help you manage all your wealth.
*Slow down*? We don't have time to slow down -- it's *crunch time*! Get your ass moving and control that crane! We've got sales to make.
*ZOOT*! *ZAP*! *POW*! *CRINKLE*! It's like magic, you feel yourself disappear, your atoms fading out of existence...
...are you *rich*?
...but there's nowhere to go. A two-story drop to the plaza mosaic -- if she could, she would've run before.
A Boring Cop? No. You're a hustler -- and you've got a long way to go. Your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
A Sorry Cop? No. You're a hustler -- and you've got a long way to go. Your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
A Superstar Cop? No. You're a hustler -- and you've got a long way to go. Your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
A faint slice of light from the curtains reveals a doorway in the back, draped in cage-like polyhedrons. They are all made of fish heads and tiny animal bones; it looks like a small graveyard...
A full suit of armour can't be too agile. You can shift direction faster than he can.
A good hiding place for someone who's up to no good.

And become a small-time art peddler? No, think bigger.

Ankles tingling from the tension, blood roaring in your ears -- you are ready for your rendezvous with the concrete pavement below.

Are you in?

As you blow this joint -- behind you a whiny voice shouts:

Attaboy, welcome to the final grind! Here we operate with money on a *much* higher level than the ordinary citizen, we feed it back into the machine. Stop saving, start spending -- become a *patron*...
Be careful where you tread in the reeds. Some less conscientious researchers may have left their traps out there -- armed, hidden.
Be very, very careful where you step here.
Beautiful things give you a *rush*. It's power -- crafting your style, draping your flesh in silk and leather, deciding how to present yourself to the world.
Beauty doesn't cut it. We have a long way to go -- your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
Because he doesn't want to be found. Smoke traces...
Because of the TAXES. G-man's got his jam-covered sticky-fingers in your pocket, stealing from you every time you buy, sell, walk, talk, fart, so much as sneeze!
Bit of corporate espionage? He's straight in there. Great job.
Blazing his own trail, being his own man... not exactly your typical communist spiel.
Boohoo, *the system is broken*. *The establishment is keeping me down...* That's not the fuck-yeah attitude you're used to, what is this? Why are you so poor?

Boots -- black in colour, crafted of hardened leather, if you had to guess. They look sturdy and stable, useful in rugged environments.
Boring... BORING... Yawning my jaw off here... Next!

But Savvy's got your back. Savvy's going to book you a charter flight with eighty birds of prey on board, to a land where the streets are paved with krugerrands and fixed-income securities. You'll try again, but this time with *money*. You'll win her back.
But be easy about it. Communists have been known to charge when startled.
But he could get in there.
But let's come back to that idea later. There's easier money to be made elsewhere. Just get that sign stuck on there for now.

By all accounts this place should be *swarming* with artist-types. It's just a matter of time until you meet one. Look for squats and cheap rentals, we might even chance upon a *political artivist* here.
Can't say that -- you *shook* him. You're a killer. A shark.
Check out the pose -- rigid as a stick. He couldn't even wipe his own ass. You don't want to be like that.
Come on, we've stood here long enough. And money doesn't sleep.
Cool. Let's do this swindle. This *tare* swindle.
Cuno knows the ladder is unclimbable.

Delivered with the smug assurance of a schoolboy reciting a maxim he's committed to memory.

Did someone say *sneak around in the cellar*? We should do that.
Didn't we talk about saying sorry? Why are you saying sorry again?

Do you see any stock markets in Martinaise? No? That's because for those living in the outskirts, the market is *nothing*. Just ghost numbers flicking through time. A spectral sport they're not invited to play.
Don't be silly, the art market isn't about art, it's about gate-keeping, speculative bidding, and showboating.
Don't listen to this fool. It's not about the artists, it's about the *buyers*. You can't hang 'vapour-porn' in the foyer of your chalet.
Don't move your head. Just from the corner of your eye -- look at her.
Don't you dare! This isn't the time. Put your personal feelings aside -- you're a salesman!
Doors, windows, toilet seats -- open whatever it is you need, buddy. Just get on with making a purchase already!
Even Cuno thinks it's unclimbable, cause the ladder is treacherously rotten, but you could use your hands and feet to reach around the tree, then hang from the branch...
Even if he tries anything, you can just *slip out of his reach* like an eel...
Even if it's a trap, you can just *slip out of his reach* like an eel...

Every time you wipe your ass! They got their direct and their *indirect modes of taxation*: sales tax, excise duty, extraction tax, alimony, one tax that doesn't even have a name! Plus there's the stuff *people in other countries* pay for, that makes them ask for more money from *you* here. Total tax duties add up to...
Everything goes dark.
Exactly. Not making money when you're asleep, are you? If you wanna be rich you better work until your fingers bleed. You can sleep when you die.
Expensive isn't everything. Bet this light doesn't even have a recognisable *brand*. And you can't exactly strut down the street and turn heads with it like you can a new Perseus Black number.
Finally, my time to shine!
For starters, you could find out what's behind that mystery door in the kitchen. If it's a secret route, she could have used that to get to the roof!
For starters, you could search the Whirling-in-Rags for hidden passages she could have used to get to the roof. There's a door in the *kitchen* I've had my eye on for a while...
For the money, baby.
Forgetting was merely a matter of convenience -- very clever!

From the eyes of a seagull: a nest of brown hair not worth the fifty foot dive. From a pedestrian on the dock: a rugged man staring out to sea, mere feet from fatality. From a guest on the balcony of the Whirling-in-Rags: a silhouette imposing enough to be seen at a distance.
Fuck, she can read lips? You should cup your mouth.
Geez, live a little. At least give things a try. It's just boots. A set of sweet, stylish boots.
Geez, you artsy types are unbearable. No wonder you struggle to make your millions...
Get outta here! You're a pauper! You work harder than *anyone*, almost rode yourself to the grave and you're still practically a *hobo* -- why is that?
Getting the corpse residue out of these boots is going to require patience. And also a huge pot full of boiling water, soap, and white vinegar.
Glimpses? Who are these people, secret agents? Stealth operatives?
Go and support her like the state never could. Everyone must know that you're a big fucking shark around here!
Go and support them like the state never could. Everyone must know that you're a big fucking shark around here!
Good -- take no responsibility for this disaster. It was supposed to *promote* you, not make people fear you.
Good -- take no responsibility over this disaster. It was supposed to *promote* you, not bore people.
Good -- take no responsibility over this disaster. It was supposed to *promote* you, not confuse people.
Good -- take no responsibility over this disaster. It was supposed to *promote* you, not mock you for your failings.
Good -- take no responsibility over this disaster. People are trying to mourn and all they can see is your gaudy figure mocking them from above.
Good call. He certainly seems the type. Let's go hustle him and score us some extreme *moolah*.
Good call. He's already handed over 100 reál. Let's hustle him for even more *moolah*.
Good call. He's definitely the type who might be interested in art. Let's go hustle him and score us some extreme *moolah*.
Good call. Sure, he said he doesn't carry much money on him, but he must have something else to trade. Let's hustle!
Good thing she's didn't say PARTY EYES loud, her mother's nearby...
Good, good, gotta spread the gospel. But talk alone doesn't bring in the cash. It's time for step two.
Great *work* ethic, friend. No one should be scared to get their hands dirty on the road to brilliant *success*.
Great idea! One of your physical assets *on display* for the public. Maybe this was a good idea after all. We could sell tickets for people to come see it, turn this into a little money churner...
Great work -- that might have done it.
Great work. I think you've got him. Let's see what he says...
Have you made all the necessary preparations? Closed all your accounts?
He *definitely* makes more money.
He ate that right up. Pretty sure you've done it.
He better not let you down again. Remember, this is *your* money and *your* reputation he's playing with.

He is neither of those, of course. He is simply a poor student, putting on airs. Also, he doesn't have the shoulders to fill out such a jacket.
He must get around a lot -- to stay undetected all these years.

He's confused now, off his balance...

He's nothing more than a middle manager living a middle-class life -- your aspirations are *much* more ambitious than that.
He's right -- everything's a contest and only the *shiftiest* competitors win.

He's right. His customers are desperates, lowlifes, and bored browsers. They don't understand *high culture*. They don't want their purchases to elevate them. They just want some old junk at a bargain price.
He's saying you climbed up there. He probably saw you do it.
Here we are. Whoever is in there definitely has money, so let's convince them to part with it for our *exclusive* piece of art.

Hold it right there! Keep your head above water, or you'll lose all those pheromones Morell sprayed on you.
Holy wow, that's *high*! You'd have to be a total madman to jump. This is certain death!

Honest. Maybe even *too* honest... Didn't we talk about giving back to the community?
How about some premium-class service over here? Like paying with net worth. Go over and ask him if you can do that.
How could you be alone? You're a *star*, man. You've got an *entourage* and adoring fans wherever you go...

I got some vibes from the harbour. Let's explore that area again. Who knows what we might find hidden among all those shipping containers.

I stand corrected.

In another life, you might've made a fine seafaring man. Who knows, you may become one yet.
Is it a *coincidence* that here we have two bad-ass jackets and two bad-ass cops?
It *seems* unclimbable, cause the ladder is treacherously rotten, but you could use your hands and feet to reach around the tree, then hang from the branch...

It could maybe roll it? Like a dung-beetle.

It's sunken too deep.

Keep it cool, baby boy. You can use this, groove with this. Play along, let him throw his weight around -- and when he throws it too much, and you've got him off guard, that's when your trip him up.
Let not failure ensnare you any further, beautiful pixie girl! Be an acrobat! A prancing faerie queen!

Let's not *completely* write it off yet. Perhaps there's a business venture to be had here. Any ideas?

Listen, if you really want to make it in the big leagues, you need to *re-conceptualize* your entire portfolio. Collecting tare and moaning about taxes is not going to cut it.

NINETY-EIGHT PERCENT OF ALL YOUR MONEY.

Not closely enough, you suspect. But still -- good idea to visit her once more.

Oh yeah! Like a horse. A work horse. For hard work.

Oh, and we should see what this net worth can do. Might score a discount, or better yet, get you some free goods. That's the kind of thing that really makes you feel like a hotshot. Ask the local merchants about it if you get the chance.
Oh, he's *totally* jealous. He can barely hold it in!
Oh, it can. But first you need to *enter* the market. Right now you're as good as Samir Loisir eating dirt in Gurdi's immense network of mines.

Once we've brought in the millions you can be a tree log for all I care, but first we've got to work on increasing your net worth.
One day, you may be able to scale this tower. But it won't be today. Neither your sinews nor your spirit could handle this ascent.
One moment you're running like the wind, then you've suddenly turned around and are giving him the finger. Furiously, with both hands. Why?!
Opening the door? C'mon, I shouldn't have to tell you that. Get me up close and I'll show you how it's done.
Overwhelm them with moves. Try to have the most moves going on.
Perhaps they've overestimated the market demand for this kind of *commentary*.

Personal Brand Strategist, huh? Not the kind of person you're likely to find around here. We'll have to ask anyone who seems like they might understand marketing, reputation management... someone who dreams big.
Pier? Buildings? Apartments? You should *explore*, maybe scale a wall?
Precinct 57 needs to double the security around her.
Primitive construction, but it does the job.
Probably not, is the answer. Which isn't to say it isn't *sometimes* still useful.

Relax, it's all part of her *image*.

Remember, this is a *buyer's* market. You're the one who's in charge of pricing.
Remember, this isn't about the art or the artist -- this needless purchase implies your *excessive wealth*. Art comes across as more tasteful than simply hanging cash on the wall.
Remember, when they come to take it *away* from you -- you *worked* for those shoes. Whether you like it or not, wearing these shoes has made you more liberal -- *ultra*liberal.
Remember, you're not just selling a painting, you're selling a *story*. Give the man a reason to throw down that paper.
Retired or not, there's still a trained killer in there.
Return without the lieutenant -- for this? Your balance organ thinks it's a waste of time.
SAVOIR FAIRE
Savvy's here, watching the little *fiasco* of the horseback monument. You should distance yourself from this project. Say it's your Personal Brand Strategist gone rogue.
Secret path, secret path, secret path!

Seemed neurological... central nervous system's really banged up.

Shares -- that's even *better*. You can do a lot with them if you play your cards right.

She won't get hurt, she'll bend out of the way.
She's gone. Face it.

Slowly, you move your hand towards the small book. Before you even can reach it, you're interrupted:

Some kind of foul play might be afoot. Theft?
Sorry, but you just don't have it in you right now.
Sounds like a winner. Good pitch.
Speaking of luxury, you should go over and ask about paying for those sneakers with your net worth.

Splendid! Your first physical asset. But no time to stop -- money grows old unless it keeps moving. You need to find a *buyer*, preferably someone who will pay a high price for such an *exclusive* piece from a local artist.
Spoken like a true hustler. We have a long way to go -- your net worth is still *nothing* if you factor in the tax!
Step aside, rank and file, Savvy's at the top of the VIP list here. That's right -- out of the way!
